Attached: 1 image

I run a news radar for Kadal that reads AI sources every six hours and ranks the week's stories by where they come from.

On 16 Nov it read 378 items from 9 to 16 Nov and grouped them into 321 stories. It reads only sources whose terms allow it: 18 lab and tool feeds, 10 GitHub release feeds, press feeds, Hacker News through Algolia, GitHub search and Hugging Face trending. No Reddit, X or YouTube scraping.

#AINews #LLM #MachineLearning
